explication: Desktop Editors is a cross-platform offline office suite. The principal workflow is: a user opens the desktop frontend, enters an editor, edits a document, then saves or exports it locally; conversion is delegated to core. web-apps and sdkjs provide the common editor runtime and client API, while optional cloud, plugin, and AI integrations extend it. No source excerpts were provided, so relationships reflect README-documented component responsibilities only.
